## Overview

You have been writing R code in [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) documents
since week 12.
This week, we will take a closer look at the three components of Quarto documents:
the **YAML header**, **code chunks** and **text**.
We will use more options to customize your documents and to
display/hide code and figures, and see what happens when you render a document.

## Lectures & Learning goals

Some of the things you will learn this week:

#### [Quarto: beyond the basics](./w14a_quarto.qmd)

-   What happens when Quarto renders a document
-   More about **YAML** syntax and useful options in the YAML header
-   More **chunk options**, and how to set them for a whole document
-   How to label chunks and include R output in your Markdown text
-   How to use RStudio's visual editor for Quarto documents
-   How to render a document to Markdown that displays well on GitHub
